Name: Futuristic Stardew U.I.
Author: Shrimpxwarrior
Description:
This mod turns the U.I. into a futuristic theme! I keep hoping one day I will turn the game to a futuristic theme for you all to enjoy. This mod only contains U.I. changes. It also is a work in progress so not all the things are changed that are going to be changed! I will add a list of all the things I got done in every update in the change log. Right now you will have to download all the files and replace them in your content folder or use the CP filesI have made this mod CP and .xnb freindly! If you use CP just drag it into your mod folder and if you are old way with .xnb files just dive into the asset folder then replace the .xnb files in the content folder! I hope you continue to enjoy this mod!

[b][u]Please:
[/u][/b]Comment or discuss what I can do for artwork as a way to improve myself and improve this themed mod you want to play on!

Downloads.Description: This adds the CP files that are much needed. I will use CP files from now on! I have also added an asset folder so you can download the CP and still be .xnb friendly to people who want to still use those
